instruction: Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.

arguments.note: The red T points left from its crossbar; the blue T points diagonally toward the front-right. I begin turning both open grippers downward while preserving these original poses.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I move inward above the two blocks, keeping clearance before completing the downward orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The inward move stopped about 3 cm short on each side. I now point the grippers straight down to obtain accurate overhead alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I approach above the narrow stems, rotating the jaws across each stem rather than around the wide crossbars.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 32 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The wrist views show both stems offset from the jaw centers. I correct the alignment and finish the stem-crossing jaw rotations above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The closer views show the stems are behind the present jaw centers. I shift back while maintaining the approach height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I bring the open jaws over the visible narrow stems and descend to just above grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both stems are between the open jaws. I make a small centering correction and lower a few millimetres before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The stems are aligned. I lower to the table-safe grasp height and close both jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both jaws have stopped on the stems. I lift both blocks, holding the blue one higher so the hands can pass at different heights.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both blocks lifted securely. I begin rotating each toward the other block's remembered orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 63 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The rotation produced a large unexpected excursion toward the other arm. I separate the left hand before attempting further orientation changes.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the hands separated, I restore a flat red block and use the opposite rotation direction to avoid the wrist's rotation limit.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I continue the rotations in manageable increments while the blocks remain clear of the table and each other.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I continue turning the held blocks toward their swapped orientations.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: These final rotations make red match the original diagonal blue T and blue match the original left-pointing red T.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I carry red below the raised blue hand toward blue's original position, keeping its diagonal orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The hands interfered and blue slipped onto the table. I withdraw the empty right hand so red can be placed safely, then blue can be recovered.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 24 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: With the right hand clear, I finish aligning red over blue's original pose and approach the tabletop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower red gently to its placement height, monitoring the nearby dropped blue block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I settle red on the table and release it before withdrawing the left hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Red is released. I retract the left hand away from the work area to inspect and recover blue.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Red now matches the original blue orientation. I approach the displaced blue stem while beginning to return the idle left wrist toward its starting orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Blue is resting on an edge. I align over its stem for recovery while moving the left arm closer to home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I close around blue's exposed stem and finish returning the left arm to its starting pose.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined home rotation was refused, so I use a smaller wrist rotation while grasping blue.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 23 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I finish closing the right gripper around blue before lifting.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The last 2 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: I transport the recovered blue block toward red's original location, beginning the turn that points its stem left.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I continue turning blue toward the original red orientation while lowering above its target.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower blue at red's original location, make the last orientation correction, and release it. The remaining motion budget is insufficient to return the right arm home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
